symptoms: Small (1-3 mm), dark brown to black angular water-soaked leaf spots
Lesion centers dry up and tear away creating a shot-hole appearance
Yellowing around lesions causing severe premature leaf drop
Raised blister-like scabs on green and ripening fruits
risk_factors: High temperatures (25-30°C) with frequent rain or overhead irrigation
High wind-driven rain spreading bacterial cells across field
Working in wet foliage spreading bacterial exudate
prevention: Use hot-water treated or certified disease-free certified seeds
Never work or prune plants when foliage is wet
Maintain strict 2-3 year crop rotation away from pepper and tomato
recommended_actions: Spray copper hydroxide combined with mancozeb or bacteriophage solutions
Remove and destroy heavily infested volunteer plants
